Name: (CP) Customize Coffee
Author: kumagabear
Description:
Do you want make drinking coffee last longer and add more speed? or make it decrease energy and decrease speed because of caffeine ? now you can!

Customize coffee or espresso effect by using [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu
[/url][/b]
You can customize [b]Speed, Duration, and Edibility
[/b]
This mod is just simply edit the fied for the item, the numeric value is following [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Items]Modding:Items[/url]﻿

For example you want to make duration last for a day you can set the duration to [b]-2[/b]
